Name: Gad the Seer
Summary: Gad the seer was David's prophet. He told the fugitive David to leave the stronghold for Judah, and after the census he gave David God's choice of punishments and told him to build the altar on Araunah's threshingfloor.
KeyStory: Gad guided David as a fugitive and confronted him after the census.
RelatedPeople: King David; Araunah the Jebusite; Nathan; King Solomon
LifeLesson: A true seer speaks when it is welcome and when it is not.
